//Cors: Localhost origins live here so they never reach the production allow-list.

Dynamo.//AutoCreateTables: Reconciles the DynamoDB schema at startup: creates missing tables and adds indexes the code declares but the deployed table lacks. On by default because the alternative was a manual console step that gets forgotten, and a missing index fails silently as a table scan. Runs in the background, so it never delays a cold start. Needs ListTables/DescribeTable/CreateTable/UpdateTable on the execution role. Set false once the schema lives in real infrastructure code.
Dynamo.//UsePublishedIndex: Reads published listings from PublishedStatus-index instead of scanning Properties. MUST stay false until every published row has been re-saved so it appears in the sparse index - see docs/data-backfill-required.md. Switching this on early empties the homepage.
